def sumOfDigits (n : Nat) (h_precond : sumOfDigits_precond (n)) : Nat :=
  n.recOn 0 fun d acc => d + acc

theorem sumOfDigits_spec_satisfied (n: Nat) (h_precond : sumOfDigits_precond (n)) :
    sumOfDigits_postcond (n) (sumOfDigits (n) h_precond) h_precond := by
  simp [sumOfDigits, sumOfDigits_precond, sumOfDigits_postcond, Nat.zero, Nat.succ]
  <;> induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      simp_all [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm,
        List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, List.map_append, List.sum_append,
        Char.toNat, Nat.repr_zero, Nat.repr_succ, Nat.add_assoc]
      <;> ring_nf at *
      <;> omega
